integrity: Formal derivation and independently executable finite consistency checks are supplied. Infinite statements rely on the algebraic proof rather than finite enumeration. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to reduced Chebyshev root divisors of degree d=(p^r+1)/2>=5 over odd-characteristic finite fields, up to ambient PGL2 equivalence; not to other degrees, curves branched along the divisor or Jacobians. The geometric dihedral stabilizer is taken from Tafazolian–Top; the exact arithmetic classification is proved here. Priority of possibly unindexed equivalent work cannot be independently certified.
title: Finite-field forms, symmetry spectra, and Frobenius cycles of exceptional Chebyshev root divisors
